docs: SPEC_SLACK1 §10.3 — mobile/Slack presentation knobs, read by shared/scripts/surface_context.py and the slack emitter (slack_render.py). This file is one of the THREE legal homes for Slack presentation (the others: a skill's `surfaces:` frontmatter and an optional `## Slack surface` block in a SKILL.md — guard G24 enforces the boundary). Retune mobile presentation by editing values here and shipping through the normal push → plugin-update ritual; no code changes. The cowork surface takes NO knobs from this file by design — desktop rendering is the untouched default and structurally cannot be changed from here.
